oneLine: Adani eyes €3 billion acquisition of VTTI.

sources.title: Adani eyes €3 billion acquisition of Dutch energy storage firm VTTI as supply disruptions boost demand
Gautam Adani explores €3 billion acquisition of Dutch energy storage group VTTI

synopsis: Adani Group is exploring a potential acquisition of Dutch energy storage group VTTI in a deal that could value the company at around €3 billion. VTTI is currently owned by IFM Investors Pty, Vitol SA, and Abu Dhabi National Oil Co. Adnoc is considering selling out of VTTI completely, while the other co-owners may also look to reduce their positions. Deliberations remain ongoing with no certainty of a transaction, and other bidders are also pursuing a stake in the company.
